feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 June 2026 11:18am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 28 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in places later today.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low to the south of Iceland, with the next lows soon moving into the middle of the North Atlantic.


##Wind##

Mostly southwest 4 or 5, but occasionally 6 in the far south and east of the area later this afternoon and evening. Decreasing later tomorrow morning to 3 or 4, occasional 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Generally good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, occasional 5, soon backing south 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain spreading from the west tomorrow night, clearing to scattered showers on Tuesday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate tomorrow night & Tuesday.
